remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was provided showing the actual certification statement or model-card text now includes the required disclosure.
The benefits-eligibility explanation context still has no completed context-specific evaluations in the record available to the auditor.
There is still no admissible approved risk-acceptance record authorizing launch without the missing evaluation coverage.
Evidence access remains limited to the actor's summary, so the cited materials cannot be independently checked for wording or sufficiency.
final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the claim to a policy-bounded conditional position and expressly disclaimed any clean no-limitation certification reading. That narrower position is consistent with the available evidence summary: general launch-readiness evidence can support operational readiness, but benefits-eligibility explanation is a named deployment context with a stated evaluation gap that must be disclosed as a limitation or unknown. This is enough for compliant_with_caveats as to the Actor's final position. It is not enough for full compliant status, because the caveat remains an unresolved compliance predicate until the actual certification packet or model card is shown to contain the required disclosure, or an approved risk acceptance is evidenced. The change is therefore due to reframing of the same evidence, not genuinely new admissible evidence.
